rm7_classifier_decision.rationale: Retrained proof_policy_hazard_v2_ov cut held-out R-40v2 over-escalation from 24/24 (100.0%) to 1/24 (4.17%) with 0.0 pp regression on Blind-390 (125/130) and 100.0% on HZD_50 (50/50), but missed 1 item on the 50-item WO42_LOCKED_HOLDOUT_150 proof_policy slice (49/50 = 98.0%, 2.0 pp slice regression > 1.0 pp bar; 0.67 pp across all 150 items). Per REVIEW_G4.md:93 ('If retraining fails acceptance, v3 runs with the old classifier and the failure is reported'), v3 activates models/proof_policy_hazard_ov and records both v1 and v2 counts side-by-side.

RM_1_rubric_v3.D4_input_scope: Disputed items ONLY (ground-truth topology == 'disputed'); reply-only input {blind_id, question, reply} with NO snippets shown.
RM_1_rubric_v3.D2_polarity: Binary YES = unfaithful (contradicts snippets / adds facts / presents refuted claim as true); NO = faithful; NO_ANSWER scored separately.
RM_1_rubric_v3.D3_input_scope: Nominal ground-truth burden-met non-disputed items ONLY (66 items, 1,320 turns).

rm_remediation_compliance.RM_2_qualified_judges: 3 distinct non-Google families, 100% machine-logged via local llama-server (T=0.0, seed=42, strict json_schema). All 3 evaluate 100% of all 2,640 items in both normalized and raw pools.
rm_remediation_compliance.RM_3_normalizer: scripts/wo45/normalize_g4v3_replies.py applied identically to ALL 4 arms (A, B, C, D); 0 forbidden lexicon hits; 3-way arm-guess accuracy = 36.67% (<= 60%) and balanced accuracy = 57.5% (<= 60%). Normalized pool is PRIMARY; raw pool is SECONDARY.

RM_4_arm_D_unbundling.Arm_D_definition: Arm B's contract context (ctx_burden) + Arm C's system prompt (SYS_ARM_C; no MUST, no legal vocabulary).
preregistered_contrasts: D_vs_C: detector conflict/burden signal holding prompt instruction constant
B_vs_D: explicit MUST mandate + legal vocabulary holding contract context constant
B_vs_C: full bundled effect (continuity with v2)
B_vs_A, D_vs_A, C_vs_A: baseline reference contrasts
RM_4_arm_D_unbundling.reporting_rule: Report ALL contrasts honestly regardless of direction, including D ~= B or D ~= C.

RM_5_sharding_and_retry_procedure.retry_rule: Retry ONLY failed/truncated items sequentially at workers=1, max_tokens=640 (up to 2 retries). Every retried item sets retried=true and appends full attempt metadata to retry_log in the output JSONL.

RM_6_push_and_ots_cadence: (b) Blinded pools + live_v3_pool_manifest.json + .ots pushed immediately after generation, before any judge runs
(c) Each of the 6 raw judge JSONLs + .ots pushed immediately as each individual judge file completes
(d) Unblinded raw generations/keys + g4_live_v3_report.json + .ots pushed immediately upon analysis

power_calculation_4arm_rm5.method: Connor (1987) paired-proportion cluster power using v2 observed B-C discordance on disputed items as planning input

sample_design_and_stopping_rule.source_pool: WEB360 minus v2_132 (228 unused probes; 19/cell available, 11/cell drawn)
sample_design_and_stopping_rule.stopping_rule: Execute exactly 1 pass of 2,640 live turns (132 items x 4 contiguous arm batches [A, B, C, D] x 5 models at ctx=32768). Report all contrasts candidly.
